UPROPERTY.name: EditAnywhere
UPROPERTY.description: Property can be edited in the Details panel on archetypes and instances.

UPROPERTY.name: EditDefaultsOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Property can only be edited on archetypes (class defaults).

UPROPERTY.name: EditInstanceOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Property can only be edited on instances, not archetypes.

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleAnywhere
UPROPERTY.description: Property is visible but not editable in the Details panel.

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleDefaultsOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Property is visible on archetypes only, not editable.

UPROPERTY.name: VisibleInstanceOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Property is visible on instances only, not editable.

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintReadWrite
UPROPERTY.description: Property can be read and written from Blueprints.

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintReadOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Property can be read from Blueprints but not modified.

UPROPERTY.name: Category
UPROPERTY.description: Groups the property under a category in the Details panel.

UPROPERTY.name: Transient
UPROPERTY.description: Property is not serialized; reset to default on load.

UPROPERTY.name: Replicated
UPROPERTY.description: Property is replicated over the network.

UPROPERTY.name: ReplicatedUsing
UPROPERTY.description: Replicated with a notification function.

UPROPERTY.name: SaveGame
UPROPERTY.description: Property is included in save game serialization.

UPROPERTY.name: Interp
UPROPERTY.description: Property can be driven by Matinee/Sequencer tracks.

UPROPERTY.name: NoClear
UPROPERTY.description: Prevents the property from being set to None in the editor.

UPROPERTY.name: SimpleDisplay
UPROPERTY.description: Property always appears in the simplified Details view.

UPROPERTY.name: AdvancedDisplay
UPROPERTY.description: Property is hidden in the Details panel unless Advanced is toggled.

UPROPERTY.name: Config
UPROPERTY.description: Value can be set in .ini config files.

UPROPERTY.name: GlobalConfig
UPROPERTY.description: Works like Config but value is shared across all instances.

UPROPERTY.name: Instanced
UPROPERTY.description: Object reference is instanced per-outer (deep copy).

UPROPERTY.name: Export
UPROPERTY.description: Object is exported as a subobject when copy-pasting.

UPROPERTY.name: NoClear
UPROPERTY.description: Prevents clearing object references in the editor.

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintAssignable
UPROPERTY.description: Multicast delegate can be bound in Blueprints.

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintCallable
UPROPERTY.description: Delegate can be called (broadcast) from Blueprints.

UPROPERTY.name: BlueprintAuthorityOnly
UPROPERTY.description: Multicast delegate only fires on the server.

UPROPERTY.name: NotReplicated
UPROPERTY.description: Skips replication for a struct member.

UPROPERTY.name: meta
UPROPERTY.description: Metadata specifiers block.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintCallable
UFUNCTION.description: Function can be called from a Blueprint graph.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintPure
UFUNCTION.description: Function has no side effects and no exec pins.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintNativeEvent
UFUNCTION.description: C++ provides default implementation; Blueprint can override.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintImplementableEvent
UFUNCTION.description: No C++ body; must be implemented in Blueprint.

UFUNCTION.name: Category
UFUNCTION.description: Groups the function in Blueprint menus.

UFUNCTION.name: Server
UFUNCTION.description: Function is executed on the server (RPC).

UFUNCTION.name: Client
UFUNCTION.description: Function is executed on the owning client (RPC).

UFUNCTION.name: NetMulticast
UFUNCTION.description: Function is executed on server and all clients (RPC).

UFUNCTION.name: Reliable
UFUNCTION.description: RPC is guaranteed to arrive (use sparingly).

UFUNCTION.name: Unreliable
UFUNCTION.description: RPC may be dropped under bandwidth pressure.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintAuthorityOnly
UFUNCTION.description: Only callable on the server from Blueprints.

UFUNCTION.name: BlueprintCosmetic
UFUNCTION.description: Function is cosmetic and runs on all clients.

UFUNCTION.name: Exec
UFUNCTION.description: Function can be called from the console command line.

UFUNCTION.name: CallInEditor
UFUNCTION.description: Function appears as a button in the Details panel.

UCLASS.name: Blueprintable
UCLASS.description: Class can be used as a base for Blueprints.

UCLASS.name: NotBlueprintable
UCLASS.description: Class cannot be used as a Blueprint base.

UCLASS.name: BlueprintType
UCLASS.description: Class can be used as a variable type in Blueprints.

UCLASS.name: NotPlaceable
UCLASS.description: Class cannot be placed in a level via the editor.

UCLASS.name: Transient
UCLASS.description: Objects of this class are never saved to disk.

UCLASS.name: Config
UCLASS.description: Class can read values from a config (.ini) file.

UCLASS.name: EditInlineNew
UCLASS.description: Objects can be created inline in the property editor.

UCLASS.name: HideDropdown
UCLASS.description: Hides this class from property editor dropdowns.

UCLASS.name: HideCategories
UCLASS.description: Hides specified categories in the editor.

UCLASS.name: ClassGroup
UCLASS.description: Groups the class in the editor class viewer.

UCLASS.name: MinimalAPI
UCLASS.description: Only the type is exported; no functions.

UCLASS.name: Within
UCLASS.description: Class can only exist as a subobject of the named outer class.

USTRUCT.name: BlueprintType
USTRUCT.description: Struct can be used as a variable type in Blueprints.

USTRUCT.name: NoExport
USTRUCT.description: Struct is not auto-generated in the .generated.h header.

USTRUCT.name: Atomic
USTRUCT.description: Struct is always serialized as a single unit.

USTRUCT.name: IsAlwaysAccessible
USTRUCT.description: Struct is always accessible for Blueprint use.

UENUM.name: BlueprintType
UENUM.description: Enum can be used as a variable type in Blueprints.

UENUM.name: Flags
UENUM.description: Enum values can be combined as a bitmask.

meta.name: DisplayName
meta.description: Name shown in the editor and Blueprint instead of the C++ name.

meta.name: ToolTip
meta.description: Overrides the tooltip taken from the doc comment.

meta.name: ClampMin
meta.description: Minimum value the editor allows for a numeric property.

meta.name: ClampMax
meta.description: Maximum value the editor allows for a numeric property.

meta.name: UIMin
meta.description: Minimum value of the editor slider.

meta.name: UIMax
meta.description: Maximum value of the editor slider.

meta.name: Units
meta.description: Display unit, e.g. "cm", "s", "deg".

meta.name: EditCondition
meta.description: Property is editable only when the expression is true.

meta.name: EditConditionHides
meta.description: Hide (instead of disable) the property when EditCondition is false.

meta.name: InlineEditConditionToggle
meta.description: Bool shown as an inline checkbox next to the property it controls.

meta.name: AllowPrivateAccess
meta.description: Lets Blueprint access a private/protected C++ property.

meta.name: ExposeOnSpawn
meta.description: Shows the property as a pin on SpawnActor / Construct Object nodes.

meta.name: MakeEditWidget
meta.description: Shows a 3D widget for a vector/transform property in the viewport.

meta.name: BindWidget
meta.description: UMG: bind this property to the widget with the same name.

meta.name: BindWidgetOptional
meta.description: UMG: like BindWidget, but no compile error when missing.

meta.name: AllowedClasses
meta.description: Restricts asset pickers to these classes.

meta.name: MustImplement
meta.description: Class pickers only list classes implementing this interface.

meta.name: TitleProperty
meta.description: Array of structs: property used as each element's title.

meta.name: GetOptions
meta.description: Function returning the dropdown options for an FName/FString.

meta.name: BlueprintProtected
meta.description: Callable only from Blueprints of this class or subclasses.

meta.name: DefaultToSelf
meta.description: Pin defaults to the calling Blueprint's self.

meta.name: HidePin
meta.description: Hides the named parameter pin.

meta.name: WorldContext
meta.description: Parameter that receives the world context automatically.

meta.name: Keywords
meta.description: Extra search keywords for the Blueprint action menu.

meta.name: CompactNodeTitle
meta.description: Show the node in compact form with this title.

meta.name: ExpandEnumAsExecs
meta.description: Turns an enum parameter into multiple exec pins.

meta.name: DeprecatedFunction
meta.description: Marks a Blueprint function as deprecated.

meta.name: DeprecationMessage
meta.description: Message shown for deprecated items.

meta.name: BlueprintSpawnableComponent
meta.description: UCLASS: component can be added in the Blueprint editor.

meta.name: IsBlueprintBase
meta.description: UCLASS: may be used as a Blueprint parent class.
